description: This file defines classes and methods for managing a gesture database in a Kivy application, including UI components, gesture import/export, and selection handling.

classes.name: GestureDatabaseItem
classes.description: UI component representing a gesture database item with selection and display logic

classes.name: GestureDatabase
classes.description: Main widget managing the collection of gesture items, import/export, and selection

methods.name: toggle_selected
methods.description: Toggles the selection state of the gesture item

methods.name: update_template_count
methods.description: Updates the count of gesture templates in the item

methods.name: draw_item
methods.description: Positions UI elements and draws rectangle around the item

methods.name: _draw_rect
methods.description: Draws or clears the rectangle around the gesture item

methods.name: import_gdb
methods.description: Loads gestures into the database and populates UI list

methods.name: select_item
methods.description: Increments the count of selected items

methods.name: deselect_item
methods.description: Decrements the count of selected items

methods.name: mass_select
methods.description: Selects or deselects all gesture items

methods.name: unload_gestures
methods.description: Removes selected gestures from the recognizer database

methods.name: perform_export
methods.description: Exports selected gestures to a file

methods.name: save_selection_to_file
methods.description: Saves selected gestures to a specified file

methods.name: _redraw_gesture_list
methods.description: Triggers redraw of gesture list UI
